_comment: Business-idea attacker/proposer pair (prompts/business-idea-attacker.md, prompts/business-idea-proposer.md). Reuses the generic vibe-app pairing mode. Claude proposes, GPT attacks, both via OpenRouter (one OPENROUTER_API_KEY). The pair is deliberately cross-vendor: this mode has a panel of ONE, so there is no second reviewer to catch a same-family attacker's blind spots. GPT takes the attacker seat because this persona checks arithmetic that has to actually hold up — CAC/LTV, margins, TAM math — where a plausible-looking wrong number is the whole failure mode. Pass --tier to override both. Run: `node orchestrate.mjs --config agents.businessidea.json --task "..."` (or --file). Converges when the attacker's strongest standing finding is at/below --floor (default LOW).
